clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Confessed her feelings and got the sweetest shy 'I like you too' back 🥺💖
Level 2: Told him she had feelings and he revealed he was planning to ask her out 😳✨
Level 3: Shy guy finally confessed on call and melted into the biggest blush ever 🥹📞
Level 4: Called her crush and he yelled 'Are you serious? It is 100% mutual!' 🎉💘
Level 5: Asked him on a date after years of friendship and he instantly said 'Absolutely' 😭❤️
